name: Sawatte! Onii-chan
source:
Your younger sister Yuina came rushing happily into your room.
Suddenly, she says that she wants you to "touch her body"...
If it's what your sister wants, as a caring brother you can't say no...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ258185.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
你的妹妹尤伊娜高兴地冲进你的房间。
突然，她说她想让你“触摸她的身体”……
如果这是你姐姐想要的，作为一个有爱心的兄弟，你不能拒绝……

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ258185.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英语[/url]]
